caseNameFull: United States v. Klein, Escheator of Pennsylvania
attorneys: Solicitor General Jackson for the United States. Messrs. Albert H. Ladner, Jr. and A. Jere. Creskoff for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Reed took no part in the *619consideration and decision of this application.' Solicitor General Jackson for the United States. Messrs. Albert H. Ladner, Jr. and A. Jere. Creskoff for respondent.
